basic_info.description: Prime location in Sunny Visitacion Valley neighborhood. This charming home features 3 bedrooms, 1.5 bathrooms. A bright, airy living room featuring hardwood floors and cozy fireplace.   Formal dining area flows into a spacious kitchen. Two bedrooms facing south with views of San Bruno mountains! The lower level features a versatile room with half bathroom. Spacious garage with high ceilings also leads out to the expansive backyard. Conveniently located near 101/280 freeways, the Bayshore Caltrain Station, MUNI transit, and McLaren Park.  This residence offers effortless access to all that the area has to offer on Leland Ave cafes, restaurants, dog washer and banks! Hop and skip to super markets, restaurants and vibrant San Bruno Ave! The home has been in the family for over 50 years! This home is ready for the next family to make it their own with some TLC (Total Love & Care). Do not miss this opportunity.
